releaseNotes: InspectOps is now Uriel Sentry. Any camera becomes a drone sentry: Drone watch and Site watch run offline on your computer, every alert is kept in a tamper-evident log, and alerts sync to VISOR when you're online. Now on Mac (Apple silicon) and Windows. Download it from arckaingel.com/tools. Your licence key and saved data carry over; sign in once after installing, then you can remove InspectOps.
